enriched_description: Medium-sized terrier with a profuse double coat resembling the Old English sheepdog. Body is compact and square-proportioned with moderate bone structure. Coat is dense and fluffy with a soft woolly undercoat and longer harsh outer coat, often appearing in white, gold, tricolor, or brindle. Tail is carried curled over the back in a distinctive fluffy plume. Feet are large and round with hair between toes, giving a snowshoe appearance. Head is moderately short with a beard and mustache framing the muzzle. Ears are pendant and heavily feathered. Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and round with an alert expression.

Toy-sized terrier with a distinctive silky blue coat that falls straight and flat along the body. Coat is fine-textured, glossy, and extends to the ground when fully grown, with a characteristic blue and tan coloration. Body is low-set and elongated with fine bone structure. Head is moderately long with a flat skull and a short, strong muzzle. Ears are small, V-shaped, and carried erect. Tail is docked and carried high. Eyes are small, dark, and round with a keen, intelligent expression. Overall appearance is elegant and refined with a ground-covering gait.

Medium-sized terrier with an abundant single coat in any shade of wheaten, ranging from pale beige to golden. Coat texture is soft, silky, and slightly wavy with a characteristic fall over the eyes. Head is heavily furnished with hair forming a distinctive beard and mustache. Body is square-proportioned and well-muscled with moderate bone. Ears are V-shaped, medium-sized, and folded forward. Tail is docked and carried gaily. Eyes are dark, round, and expressive beneath the shaggy facial hair. The breed's signature feature is the uniform wheaten coloration with no other colors present.

Small terrier with a distinctive pure white double coat consisting of a harsh, straight outer coat approximately 2 inches long and a soft, dense undercoat. Body is compact and short-coupled with a level topline and deep chest. Head is proportionate with a slightly domed skull and a gradual stop. Muzzle is strong and tapers slightly. Ears are small, pointed, and carried erect. Tail is short, thick, and carried gaily but not curled over the back. Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and set wide apart with a piercing, alert expression. Legs are short and muscular with round, compact feet.

Small terrier-type dog with a long, heavy, dense double coat that reaches the ground. Coat is straight, hard in texture, and parts naturally along the spine. Colors include gold, sandy, honey, grizzle, slate, smoke, black, white, or brown. Body is well-balanced and longer than tall with a level topline. Head features a heavy fall of hair over the eyes and a prominent beard and mustache. Muzzle is approximately 2 inches long. Ears are pendant and heavily feathered. Tail is well-feathered and carried curled over the back. Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and oval-shaped. The breed's characteristic gait is smooth and effortless.

Medium-large sporting dog with a distinctive shiny, flat-lying coat in solid black or liver. Coat is dense, fine-to-medium in texture, and lies close to the body with moderate feathering on chest, legs, and tail. Body is well-proportioned with a level topline and powerful hindquarters built for swimming. Head is long and lean with a flat skull and powerful jaws. Ears are small, well-set, and lie close to the head. Tail is straight and carried level with the back, well-feathered. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, eager expression. Gait is smooth and efficient with strong drive from the rear.

Large retriever distinguished by a tightly curled, crisp coat covering the entire body in solid black or liver. Coat consists of dense, small, tight curls lying close to the skin, providing waterproof protection. Body is strong and well-balanced with a slightly sloping topline and deep chest. Head is wedge-shaped with a flat skull and long, powerful muzzle. Ears are small, set high, and lie flat against the head with a slight curl. Tail is short, straight, and carried level. Eyes are large, oval, and dark with an intelligent expression. The curly coat is the breed's most distinctive feature, setting it apart from other retrievers.

Medium-large sporting dog with a long, silky golden coat ranging from light cream to dark golden. Coat is dense and water-repellent with a thick undercoat and moderate feathering on neck, back of legs, and underside of tail. Body is well-proportioned, powerful, and balanced with a level topline. Head is broad with a straight muzzle and friendly, intelligent expression. Ears are medium-sized, pendant, and set at approximately eye level. Tail is thick at the base with a feathered plume, carried level or with a slight upward curve. Eyes are dark brown, medium-large, and set well apart with a kind, expressive gaze.

Medium-large retriever with a short, dense, hard coat in solid black, yellow, or chocolate brown. Coat is straight and weather-resistant with a thick, protective undercoat. Body is strong, muscular, and well-balanced with a broad chest and powerful hindquarters. Head is clean-cut with a broad skull and strong jaws. Ears are pendant, medium-sized, and set back from the skull. Tail is thick at the base, tapering toward the tip, forming the characteristic 'otter tail' carried high. Eyes are medium-sized, brown or hazel, with an intelligent, kindly expression. Overall build is athletic and built for swimming and retrieving.

Medium-large retriever with a distinctive short, thick, oily coat ranging from brown to light tan, often described as 'deadgrass' colored. Coat is dense with a fine, woolly undercoat and a greasy, waterproof outer coat that is the breed's hallmark. Body is powerful and well-balanced with a deep chest and strong hindquarters. Head is broad and round with a medium-length muzzle. Ears are small, pendant, and set high. Tail is medium-length, slightly curved, and moderately feathered. Eyes are yellowish or amber, medium-sized, and set wide apart with an intelligent, alert expression. The wavy or curly coat texture and distinctive coloration differentiate this breed from other retrievers.
